data.standardized_narrative: The report's balance sheet shows gross claims outstanding at the prior year (2015) at approximately GBP 371.26m. The document does not present a clearly labelled gross 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' figure in the accessible pages, so a quantified gross prior-year development amount could not be identified with confidence from the provided images.
data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from the liabilities section ('Claims outstanding') prior-year (2015) column on the Statement of Financial Position (liabilities) (page ~14 of provided images). The PDF images are low resolution and rotated; specific notes that would show a gross prior-year movement (a 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' note or an explicit gross PYD figure) were not legible / not found in the supplied images. A claims development (triangle) table appears later in the notes (pages ~37-38) but the table values could not be confidently extracted from the images to compute a gross prior-year development. Therefore prior_year_development_gbp_m is returned as null. Many fields are left empty for lack of a clear, legible gross source.
